source.text:
# Mutable accumulator loop (RT-4 letrec shape). The loop body reads the
# accumulator at two sites (`total + total`), so the induction phase substitutes
# the read-your-writes value twice per step — the copies (and the step_view
# scaffolding clones) must carry freshened (unique) NodeIds.
total := 0
for i in [1, 2, 3]:
    total := total + total + i
total
